description: This file is a shell test script for Git, verifying handling of large blobs and related operations such as adding large files, configurations, packing, diffing, and archiving.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the given commands and checks the outcome.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the previous command failed as expected.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_file_size
methods.description: Returns the size of a specified file.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks that a specified path exists and is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a specified path does not exist.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository for testing.

methods.name: test_tool genrandom
methods.description: Generates random data of specified size.

methods.name: test_oid algo
methods.description: Returns object IDs using specified algorithm.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
